podcast.body: A reinterpreted mix of this song is featured on Linkin Park's 2002 remix album, Reanimation. The new vocal contribution on this particular track comes from Jay Gordon, who is the lead singer of the San Francisco-based band Orgy. "This is the reinterpreted mix of points of authority from Lincoln Park's Reanimation album from 2002."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Originally from *Hybrid Theory*, this track was remixed and reinterpreted for the *Reanimation* album and released as a single on July 15, 2002. It served as a representative sample of the remix album's content. "This is Points of Authority, which came out as a single on July 15th, 2002."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
